name: askaroll
description: Ask your players to make rolls for you.

scripts.deploy: node --env-file-if-exists=.env -e "const fs=require('node:fs'); const childProcess=require('node:child_process'); const target=process.env.DEPLOY_DIST_PATH; if (!target) throw new Error('DEPLOY_DIST_PATH is required'); childProcess.execFileSync('rm', ['-rf', '-I', target], { stdio: 'inherit' }); fs.mkdirSync(target, { recursive: true }); fs.cpSync('dist', target, { recursive: true, force: true });"
